<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
It seems my previous attempt to find a common slot was unsuccessful. Alison has now suggested a more systematic approach: we should both share the complete availability of the partners whose calendars we can access. This will allow us to compare the two lists and find a common slot for all four partners.

I have already done the work of finding the common free slots for Elena and David in my previous session. I will now format this information and share it with Alison in the workspace.

Here are the common free slots for Elena and David that I found in the last session:
*   **Monday:** 11:00-12:00 (11:00, 11:30)
*   **Tuesday:** 09:00-10:00 (09:00, 09:30)
*   **Wednesday:** 13:00-14:00 (13:00, 13:30)
*   **Thursday:** 09:30-10:00 (09:30), 14:30-15:30 (14:30, 15:00)
*   **Friday:** 15:00-16:00 (15:00, 15:30)

However, I should double-check my work to ensure I have not missed any slots. I will review the calendars of Elena and David again to be thorough.

**Elena's Free Times:**
*   **Mon:** 10:00-10:30, 11:00-12:00
*   **Tue:** 09:00-10:00, 11:00-12:00, 14:00-14:30
*   **Wed:** 09:30-10:00, 12:00-12:30, 13:00-14:00
*   **Thu:** 09:30-10:00, 12:00-12:30, 14:30-15:30,
*   **Fri:** 10:30-11:00, 13:00-13:30, 15:00-16:00

**David's Free Times:**
*   **Mon:** 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:30-15:00
*   **Tue:** 09:00-10:00
*   **Wed:** 11:30-12:00, 13:00-14:00, 16:00-16:30
*   **Thu:** 09:30-10:30, 14:30-16:00
*   **Fri:** 12:30-13:00, 13:30-14:00, 14:30-16:30

**Common Free Slots for Elena and David:**
*   **Mon:** 11:00-12:00 (11:00, 11:30)
*   **Tue:** 09:00-10:00 (09:00, 09:30)
*   **Wed:** 13:00-14:00 (13:00, 13:30)
*   **Thu:** 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30 (14:30, 15:00)
*   **Fri:** 15:00-16:00 (15:00, 15:30)

My initial list was correct. I will now post this to the shared workspace for Alison. After that, I'll end my session and wait for her response.
